name: LP333 ID5 phase-seeded Kissat from audited tabu objective 4512
hypothesis: Mapping Kissat's forced all-true primary phases to the independently audited campaign-record objective-4512 ID5 endpoint may find a verified SAT model more quickly than default phases or the bounded objective-8256 pilot.
evidence_unit: one deterministic 3600-second Kissat 4.0.4 run at seed 0 on the exact ID5 CNF after the SHA-256-pinned 114-variable literal renaming derived from the audited objective-4512 endpoint, with phase true, forcephase true, and rephase false
claim_boundary: Only a complete transformed model that satisfies the renamed CNF, decodes through the inverse literal map, satisfies the original ID5 CNF, and independently verifies both length-333 rows plus all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations decides ID5. UNKNOWN and proofless UNSAT decide nothing.

baseline.evidence: The source ID5 endpoint independently passes every subgroup, forced-margin, PAF, stored-score, source, binary, and mutation check at objective 4512, L1 residual 600, and maximum absolute residual 12. The default one-hour ID5 Kissat arm and the objective-8256 phase pilot returned UNKNOWN.
baseline.measurement: The renamed CNF has 218018 variables and 1366261 clauses, identical to the original dimensions. A full independent stream audit verified every literal occurrence and all 226 primary phase mappings.

intervention.one_change: Use the audited objective-4512 tabu endpoint as the exact 114-variable literal-renaming map, so renamed phase true represents all 226 ID5 orbit signs; keep Kissat phase true, forcephase true, rephase false, seed 0, and all original clauses and auxiliaries.
forbidden_confounds: a heuristic other than the audited objective-4512 endpoint
accepting a transformed or decoded model without direct verification

controls.expected: Formula SHA-256 038fc7e2b084351e5fb1ee17c38e50eeaf83c1d7ce3841ab0a7ccbf7124e590e has the original 218018 variables and 1366261 clauses; an independent line-by-line audit verifies every literal occurrence.

controls.expected: Heuristic SHA-256 ea5f0e1743f54d1c4d49dbd235a1fe263eed462719ba95e75a9da0dc5be7f089 reconstructs objective 4512 and the exact ID5 margins; all-true renamed phases invert to all 226 orbit signs, and deleting one flip breaks the map.

controls.name: sat-positive-control
controls.purpose: Show the pinned solver can return and serialize a SAT model.
controls.expected: Before the target, Kissat solves the pinned profile-cell SAT fixture and its complete model satisfies every fixture clause.

controls.name: bidirectional-model-check
controls.expected: Any SAT model satisfies the transformed CNF; after inverse-renaming all 114 flipped primaries, it satisfies the original CNF and the independent family verifier confirms both full rows, subgroup invariance, and every nonzero combined PAF equation.

primary_metric.name: directly verified SAT model for fixed family ID5

terminal_outcomes.promote: Kissat returns SAT and the transformed-CNF, inverse-renaming, original-CNF, and direct LP333 audits all pass.
terminal_outcomes.park: The frozen 3600-second run returns no SAT model; preserve UNKNOWN or proofless UNSAT as nondecisive workload evidence.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A process, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen schedule before a terminal manifest is written.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any formula hash, literal-renaming, heuristic mapping, tool pin, positive control, transformed model, decoded model, original CNF, or direct LP333 check fails.

stop_rules: Run only the pinned transformed formula and scripts with Kissat seed 0, phase true, forcephase true, and rephase false.
Use exactly the independently audited objective-4512 heuristic and 114-variable flip set.
Stop immediately after a directly verified SAT model.
Otherwise stop at 3600 seconds without another phase policy, seed, heuristic, or cap.
Do not interpret UNKNOWN or proofless UNSAT as a family decision.
Do not promote a SAT marker until both transformed and decoded direct audits pass.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, construct H668, verify exact orthogonality and artifact hashes independently, and package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the endpoint and compare its telemetry with the default, objective-8256, and objective-5280 phase arms before selecting another exact mechanism.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interruption and resume only the remaining frozen wall budget if reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest formula map, phase runner, decoder, or verifier defect.

authority.data_scope: Local source-pinned formulas, solver binaries, public prompt artifacts, and generated local results are authorized for the autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared; actual external submission remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
